see_for_yourself.expected: Both windows list you as organizer and Cellist as member; only your window shows the invite link.
steps: cd project && corepack pnpm run dev
Open the printed URL and create a group called Thursday Quartet with your name
Copy the invite link, open it in a private window and join as Cellist
Refresh the group page in both windows

see_for_yourself.expected: The blank name is refused with a readable message and the altered link shows a clear not-found page.

Open the invite link with a few characters changed

see_for_yourself.expected: Forms and the invite link work without zooming or sideways scrolling, and long names wrap.

Open the network URL on a phone on the same network
Try a very long group or display name
see_for_yourself.title: On a phone

what_just_landed.detail: The start page has a form for a group name and your name; submitting it creates the group with you as its organizer and opens the group page.
what_just_landed.title: Create a group

what_just_landed.detail: Organizers see a hard-to-guess invite link with a Copy button; on a phone over plain HTTP the button selects the link and asks you to press and hold instead.
what_just_landed.title: Invite link for organizers

what_just_landed.detail: Opening the invite link shows the group name and a name field; joining adds you to the member list, and the same device is recognized when it comes back.
what_just_landed.title: Join by name, no account

what_just_landed.detail: Groups and members are stored in a local SQLite file (data/music-chairs.sqlite in project/), with no database service to run.
what_just_landed.title: Data that survives restarts
